_provenance: Hand-curated by Ian Kolaja while collecting the first ~50 report PDFs. Recovered from a markdown cell in 3_knn_imputation.ipynb before that notebook became a thin caller. The cell was never executed, so this was archived intent rather than live data.
_why_kept: The only human-labelled check on the automated results in output/availability.csv. On entries labelled 'paywalled' the automated Unpaywall check agrees 5/5. On 'available' the two disagree, most likely because 'available' here means reachable through Berkeley's library, whereas Unpaywall measures open access -- a stricter and different question. That gap is worth remembering when quoting either number.

_structure.with_uncertainty: EXFOR entries that DO report uncertainties (KNN candidates)

_categories.available: full text obtainable by the author
_categories.private: private communication; no published document exists
_categories.data_only: EXFOR entry carries data but no retrievable report
